verdict.rationale: Stagehand sends page data to LLMs and caches results server-side, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The pack has no documented training opt-out or no-training guarantee. The related items, server-side caching and regional data residency, are adjacent controls and earn no credit.
